problem_text:
A city aims to develop a strategy to curb nutrient runoff from several agricultural fields into a nearby watershed. Initially, no mitigation practices have been implemented.

The characteristics of each field are as follows:
* For Field 1, the runoff coefficient is 1.93, and the cultivated area is 261.355.
* For Field 2, the runoff coefficient is 0.975, and the cultivated area is 260.16.
* For Field 3, the runoff coefficient is 2.316, and the cultivated area is 269.124.
* For Field 4, the runoff coefficient is 1.056, and the cultivated area is 95.284.
* For Field 5, the runoff coefficient is 1.837, and the cultivated area is 74.401.
* For Field 6, the runoff coefficient is 2.462, and the cultivated area is 81.986.
* For Field 7, the runoff coefficient is 2.766, and the cultivated area is 114.663.
* For Field 8, the runoff coefficient is 2.18, and the cultivated area is 252.086.
* For Field 9, the runoff coefficient is 1.768, and the cultivated area is 240.73.

To reduce runoff, several best management practices (BMPs) are available, each with a specific effectiveness rate:
* By implementing Practice1, nutrient loss will be reduced by 75%
* By implementing Practice2, nutrient loss will be reduced by 36%
* By implementing Practice3, nutrient loss will be reduced by 63%
* By implementing Practice4, nutrient loss will be reduced by 83%
* By implementing Practice5, nutrient loss will be reduced by 62%
* By implementing Practice6, nutrient loss will be reduced by 31%
* By implementing Practice7, nutrient loss will be reduced by 65%
* By implementing Practice8, nutrient loss will be reduced by 27%
* By implementing Practice9, nutrient loss will be reduced by 64%

Adopting a practice on a field incurs an implementation cost per unit area. The cost matrix for all field–practice combinations is as follows:

| Field \ Practice | Practice1 | Practice2 | Practice3 | Practice4 | Practice5 | Practice6 | Practice7 | Practice8 | Practice9 |
|--|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|
| Field 1 | 59.506 | 65.87 | 171.731 | 99.402 | 174.615 | 120.879 | 189.417 | 23.531 | 178.991 |
| Field 2 | 105.091 | 174.825 | 82.517 | 66.688 | 20.272 | 172.306 | 36.099 | 48.056 | 87.746 |
| Field 3 | 118.187 | 182.258 | 96.939 | 70.113 | 145.977 | 157.999 | 102.64 | 129.896 | 43.597 |
| Field 4 | 130.555 | 10.896 | 61.97 | 154.627 | 42.035 | 155.252 | 103.02 | 155.078 | 26.728 |
| Field 5 | 126.751 | 130.363 | 86.645 | 193.412 | 82.83 | 17.168 | 47.889 | 80.889 | 12.675 |
| Field 6 | 71.22 | 168.313 | 46.21 | 138.582 | 129.071 | 57.276 | 141.77 | 75.426 | 34.497 |
| Field 7 | 82.875 | 121.847 | 41.734 | 166.53 | 66.658 | 65.257 | 148.288 | 123.31 | 74.189 |
| Field 8 | 178.715 | 199.14 | 75.119 | 181.263 | 78.258 | 45.801 | 190.136 | 184.459 | 86.644 |
| Field 9 | 53.399 | 148.162 | 34.929 | 149.475 | 122.042 | 42.107 | 79.652 | 133.603 | 17.099 |

You must decide which practices to apply to each field (fields may adopt multiple practices concurrently), and a field may also remain partially untreated if needed. The objective is to guarantee that the total nutrient runoff is diminished by at least a proportion P = 0.638 of the baseline amount, while minimizing the aggregate implementation expenditure.
